description: This Java class defines the ConceptMapType entity used within the OpenMRS project. It models different types of concept mappings (e.g., IS_A, SAME_AS) and includes properties such as an ID and a hidden flag, along with associated getters, setters, and annotations for persistence and serialization.

classes.name: ConceptMapType
classes.description: Represents a type of concept mapping in the OpenMRS system, including properties such as ID and visibility.

methods.name: getConceptMapTypeId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the ConceptMapType.

methods.name: setConceptMapTypeId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the ConceptMapType.

methods.name: getIsHidden
methods.description: Returns whether this concept map type is hidden.

methods.name: setIsHidden
methods.description: Sets whether this concept map type should be hidden.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID, overriding method from OpenmrsObject interface.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID, overriding method from OpenmrsObject interface.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the ConceptMapType, or an empty string if the name is null.

methods.name: isHidden
methods.description: Deprecated method that indicates whether this concept map type is hidden.
